Class Holograms

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.holograms.api.Holograms
public final class Holograms extends Object
Floating text and floating items, for any plugin. Everything shown belongs to an owner (your plugin's name), so one call takes it all away again in your shutdown(): 
Hologram sign = Holograms.text("myplugin", world, new Vector3d(10.5, 66, 4.5),
        List.of(Message.raw("Welcome!"), Message.translation("server.myplugin.sign.hint")));
sign.setLines(...);                    // players see the new text within a moment
FloatingItem gem = Holograms.item("myplugin", world, new Vector3d(10.5, 65, 4.5), "Rock_Gem_Ruby");
gem.glow("#FF4060");                   // a coloured light
gem.moveTo(...);                        // on the world thread it moves at once; call it every tick to animate
Holograms.removeAll("myplugin");       // in shutdown()
Lines are Messages: translation keys are shown in each player's language, and placeholders such as {lottery_pot} are filled in for each player. Nothing is saved with the world; things are shown only while a player is near (the distance is a setting). Any thread may call these.

    • statue

      public static Statue statue(String owner, String worldName, org.joml.Vector3d position, UUID player)
      A life-size figure of a player, as they looked when last seen, turning to face the nearest player; its feet at the position. Shows nothing for a player Holograms has not seen join (or null). Since API_VERSION 2.

    • coloured

      public static TextImage coloured(String owner, String worldName, org.joml.Vector3d position, Supplier<List<com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.Message>> lines)
      Coloured floating text (Colours codes: &c, <#FF8800>, <gradient:#F00:#00F>), drawn into a picture that everyone sees the same (see TextImage). The supplier runs now and on every refresh; its foot is at the position. Nothing shows if this server cannot draw text (TextImage.isAvailable()). Since API_VERSION 3.

    • welcome

      public static void welcome(com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.PlayerRef player)
      Sends a player who just joined the pictures of the coloured holograms, then shows those again so their game uses them. Holograms calls this itself when a player is ready; other plugins do not need to.
